notes.title: Spring Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792092/837cfffdc90a60132f6850d25657668f09e1cf47.png[/img]
Good day, Commanders.
It's been a few months since the last update, but we haven't forgotten about you. We're coming with another handful of features and fixes.

[b]New languages[/b]
Yes, even more - and it's all thanks to our community! Now, in addition to 19 existing translations, you can play Blaze in Space: Beat a-Maze in Bashkir, Greek, Czech, Belarusian and Latin American Spanish. We are still encouraging everyone to add missing languages [url=https://crwd.in/blaze-in-space]here[/url]. And don't forget to ping us for a Community Translator role on [url=https://discord.gg/cTgPwSjcbe]Discord[/url] if you decide to help.

[b]Avatars on leaderboards[/b]
Until now, you've only been able to see your Steam friends' avatars on leaderboards. With the latest update this changes and you will also see portraits of all your competitors. Find the fastest route and everyone will see who they are dealing with!

[b]Improvements and fixes[/b]
We added minor visual and optimization tweaks for a smoother experience.

Until May 1st, you can grab Blaze in Space with a [b]-30% discount![/b]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/cTgPwSjcbe]Discord[/url] to stay in touch, share your best routes and new high scores.

Have a blast with the latest update!

notes.title: December 2022 Major Update
notes.content:
Commanders, we have a big update for you.

[b]View your rank from the Subhub[/b]
A requested feature, finally here! Monitor your leaderboard position without the need to complete the level first - yes, we know, it was quite tiresome before. Now you can easily see when it's time to try beating the level again.

[b]New languages[/b]
Thanks to our amazing community translators, the game is now available in 3 new languages: Indonesian, Turkish and Arabic (so that's 19 in total [including Pirate-English]!). And remember, if Blaze in Space is not yet localized in yours, you can change it here: https://crwd.in/blaze-in-space. Don't forget to ping us for a Community Translator role on [url=https://discord.gg/cTgPwSjcbe]Discord[/url] if you decide to help!

[b]Avatars on leaderboards[/b]
Face your competitors. Now leaderboards show not only nicknames, but your friends' avatars as well. Keep your reflexes sharp to make yourself truly recognizable among your gaming buddies.

[b]No Windows? No problem.[/b]
Here comes native build for Linux. This, combined with the game's low system requirements, makes it playable on almost [i]any[/i] PC. And not only PC...

[b]Play on Steam Deck[/b]
Beat your own best times during daily commuting, or plan the new best route while chilling on a couch. Blaze in Space is perfect for a few-minute sessions and will be with you whenever you need to flex your brain and test your reflexes. Take it anywhere with your Steam Deck!

[b]Other small fixes[/b]
Better looking pause menu, new animations and some minor bugfixes. Nothing fancy, but a proof we are constantly working on improving your experience, even in the smallest ways.

To celebrate this update, we offer you a discount - Blaze in Space is 25% OFF till 12 December 2022.
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/cTgPwSjcbe]Discord[/url] to stay in touch, share your best routes and new high scores.

We hope you'll have a blast!
